source.heading: Appendix C: Scenario Generator > 4. Generic AA Action Tables

entries: Move forces to take or hold the contested place
Show force to back its claim: a march, a review, a patrol
Demand concessions from [target] under threat of force
Strike [target]'s exposed asset: a depot, an escort, an outpost
Recruit, hire or resupply
Open hostilities against [target]

source.heading: Appendix C: Scenario Generator > 4. Generic AA Action Tables

entries: Buy what its objective needs: votes, land, loyalty
Fund a faction whose success serves its objective
Call in debts from, or raise prices on, [target]
Buy up or cut off [target]'s supplies or credit
Move its money to safety
Freeze credit or trade across the region

source.heading: Appendix C: Scenario Generator > 4. Generic AA Action Tables

entries: Assert control of its ground: tolls, permits, patrols
Grant passage to a faction that serves its objective
Close its route or territory to [target]
Raise the price of passage for [target]
Fortify, survey or settle its ground
Cut the route entirely until its terms are met

source.heading: Appendix C: Scenario Generator > 4. Generic AA Action Tables

entries: Spread its version of the crisis
Trade a secret to a faction that serves its objective
Investigate [target] (on a success, roll its Secret Table)
Leak something damaging about [target]
Plant agents, or protect its own sources
Publish a revelation that changes the crisis

source.heading: Appendix C: Scenario Generator > 4. Generic AA Action Tables

entries: Proclaim the rule by which the crisis must be settled
Recognize or endorse a faction that serves its objective
Withhold recognition from [target], and denounce it
Produce a precedent, document or ruling against [target]
Convene a council, summit or hearing
Name a successor, deliver a verdict, or cast someone out

source.heading: Appendix C: Scenario Generator > 4. Generic AA Action Tables

entries: Rally in the streets for its demand
Lend its numbers to a faction that serves its objective
Strike, boycott or picket [target]
Occupy or wreck [target]'s property
Organize: choose leaders, raise a fund, recruit
Rise: a general strike or open revolt
